subject: Number of free parameters, datapoints, degrees of freedom

messages.author: 737df221597ac361
messages.subject: Number of free parameters, datapoints, degrees of freedom
parts:
Hi,

Based on "lavaan: internals" "Utrecht – April 24, 2012" downloaded from the internet:

To get number of free parameters,
lavaan:::getNPAR(ParTable)
To get number of datapoints,
lavaan:::getNDAT(ParTable)
To get degrees of freedom,
lavaan:::getDF(ParTable)

The results are relevant for model identification. In a previous version of lavaan, it worked fine. But now I received the next error messages:

> lavaan:::getNPAR(ParTable) # number of free parameters
Error in get(name, envir = asNamespace(pkg), inherits = FALSE) : 
  object 'getNPAR' not found
> lavaan:::getNDAT(ParTable) #number of data
Error in get(name, envir = asNamespace(pkg), inherits = FALSE) : 
  object 'getNDAT' not found
> lavaan:::getDF(ParTable) # degrees of freedom
Error in get(name, envir = asNamespace(pkg), inherits = FALSE) : 
  object 'getDF' not found

Are there another way to get this information?

Thanks!

Alex

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Number of free parameters, datapoints, degrees of freedom
parts:
On 03/19/2014 01:07 AM, golo...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hi,
>
> Based on "lavaan: internals" "Utrecht – April 24, 2012" downloaded from
> the internet:
>
> To get number of free parameters,
> lavaan:::getNPAR(ParTable)
> To get number of datapoints,
> lavaan:::getNDAT(ParTable)
> To get degrees of freedom,
> lavaan:::getDF(ParTable)

Many (internal!) function names have changed in 0.5-16. Try:

lavaan:::lav_partable_npar(ParTable)
lavaan:::lav_partable_ndat(ParTable)
lavaan:::lav_partable_df(ParTable)

Perhaps, some of these should be made public.

Yves.
